title: A parachute tears only for an item moving right or down
description: Floating down a shaft, the player throws a rock up at the wall beside him. It bounces back left through the canopy, which holds. In the next shaft he throws one at the other wall: it bounces back right through the canopy, which tears away, and he drops.
